hematology-h07.title: 克隆性造血与骨髓增生异常性肿瘤（MDS）
hematology-h07.first_pass_focus: 把病态/无效造血、克隆证据、blast与风险连成MDS进展轴。
hematology-h07.stop_line: 不提前展开H8–H11亚型；分子/肿瘤底座归B/O9。
hematology-h07.recall_spine: 病态 / 无效造血 → blast、分型、克隆证据与风险 → MDS 与巨幼 / AA → 风险结果到治疗，再回病例算法

c-h07-lg01.label: 病态 / 无效造血：工厂在转，但产品不合格
c-h07-lg01.goal: connect abnormal clone → dysplastic maturation → ineffective output, then use peripheral counts/Ret and marrow morphology to prove that active marrow does not equal effective hematopoiesis.
c-h07-lg01.closure: from cytopenia plus marrow activity/morphology, explain why MDS differs from simple nutrient deficiency and from AA low-production failure; name what dysplasia can prove and what it cannot prove alone.
c-h07-lg01.continuity_rationale: identity, peripheral output and three-lineage dysplasia are one upstream disease model; the detailed morphology list remains visual/MI-D rather than a separate memorization group.

c-h07-lg02.label: blast、分型、克隆证据与风险：分类表必须挂回同一进展轴
c-h07-lg02.goal: treat FAB/WHO names, FISH and IPSS-R as different views of one question: how far the abnormal clone has progressed and how dangerous it is.
c-h07-lg02.closure: given blast percentage, Auer status, cytogenetics and blood counts, state which evidence defines category, which proves clonality, which estimates prognosis, and when the case leaves MDS for H9 acute leukemia.
c-h07-lg02.continuity_rationale: KP05–09 share one risk/progression axis. H7-SB01 and H7-SB02 remain explicit; no external classification/treatment update is imported.

c-h07-lg03.label: MDS 与巨幼 / AA：先分“原料成熟失败、工厂熄火、克隆性病态”
c-h07-lg03.goal: distinguish MDS from megaloblastic anemia and AA using marrow activity, dysplasia/clonal evidence, Ret, morphology and nutrient evidence.
c-h07-lg03.closure: solve a macrocytic/pancytopenic vignette by naming the single discriminator that changes the next owner rather than pattern-matching “big cells” or “three lines low”.
c-h07-lg03.continuity_rationale: these are the two highest-value false neighbors of MDS.

c-h07-lg04.label: 风险结果到治疗，再回病例算法
c-h07-lg04.goal: map Current Source risk/age/blast/cytogenetic information onto chemotherapy, HSCT, hypomethylating or special 5q treatment roles, then re-run the full MDS algorithm.
c-h07-lg04.closure: from a fresh case, establish MDS first, risk it second, and only then choose the Source-supported treatment role; explicitly reject “classification name → automatic treatment” shortcuts.
c-h07-lg04.continuity_rationale: treatment only makes sense after the risk model; KP13 enforces the reasoning order.

hematology-h08.title: 多发性骨髓瘤（MM）
hematology-h08.first_pass_focus: 把浆细胞克隆、M蛋白与CRAB/器官损害连成MM模型，再进入诊断分期和治疗角色。
hematology-h08.stop_line: 不复制肾科/骨科完整处理或外部骨髓瘤指南。
hematology-h08.recall_spine: 浆细胞克隆怎样同时形成 CRAB → M蛋白 / 轻链 → 诊断 + 分期 → 治疗候选、预后与器官威胁 → 最终 MM 病例算法

c-h08-lg01.label: 浆细胞克隆怎样同时形成 CRAB
c-h08-lg01.goal: separate abnormal plasma cells from their secreted product, then connect marrow occupation / bone destruction to anemia, bone disease, hypercalcemia and secondary organ effects.
c-h08-lg01.closure: from bone pain + anemia/high calcium/renal clues, reconstruct the common plasma-cell-clone upstream rather than treating CRAB as four unrelated diseases.
c-h08-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP01–04 establish the cell/structure arm of MM before protein-mediated effects enter.

c-h08-lg02.label: M蛋白 / 轻链：蛋白多为什么反而感染、黏、出血、伤肾
c-h08-lg02.goal: connect monoclonal protein excess to loss of normal polyclonal immunity, hyperviscosity, rouleaux/ESR, bleeding/amyloid interfaces and overflow light-chain renal injury; use the case portrait only as a combined clue set.
c-h08-lg02.closure: given TP/Alb, BJP, ESR/rouleaux, infection or renal findings, identify which protein-mediated mechanism is active and state why one M-protein clue is not the whole diagnosis.
c-h08-lg02.continuity_rationale: these KPs are the secretion-product arm of the same clone. H8-SB01/H8-SB02 stay Source-bound.

c-h08-lg03.label: 诊断 + 分期：证明克隆后，再压缩肿瘤负荷与肾/风险
c-h08-lg03.goal: establish MM using marrow monoclonal plasma cells + M-protein evidence, then distinguish D-S tumor-load/A-B renal axes from ISS β2-MG/albumin risk compression.
c-h08-lg03.closure: given diagnostic evidence and staging values, state what proves MM, what only stages it, and why BJP negativity or one organ finding cannot replace the two main diagnostic evidence lines.
c-h08-lg03.continuity_rationale: diagnosis and staging are sequential evidence decisions; numerical tables stay attached to their purpose rather than becoming standalone memory islands.

c-h08-lg04.label: 治疗候选、预后与器官威胁
c-h08-lg04.goal: use symptom/organ-damage status and transplant candidacy for Current Source therapy while keeping immediate threats (hypercalcemia, renal damage, cord compression) visible.
c-h08-lg04.closure: identify whether the case first needs threat recognition versus routine induction planning and choose the Source-supported transplant/non-transplant treatment role without importing newer regimens.
c-h08-lg04.continuity_rationale: treatment and prognosis are downstream of disease burden and organ threat, not separate drug-list tasks.

c-h08-lg05.label: 最终 MM 病例算法
c-h08-lg05.goal: compress clone → protein → organ damage → diagnostic proof → stage → treatment candidate into one executable route.
c-h08-lg05.closure: solve a fresh MM-like vignette while explicitly rejecting “bone pain = MM”, “M spike = complete diagnosis”, and “BJP negative = no MM”.
c-h08-lg05.continuity_rationale: this singleton is the Block execution algorithm.

hematology-h09.title: 急性白血病
hematology-h09.first_pass_focus: 从急性白血病身份到系别/亚型证据，再并行识别APL/DIC、白细胞淤滞、TLS等危险出口。
hematology-h09.stop_line: 不扩现代WHO/ICC与外部治疗指南；Source冲突保持显式。
hematology-h09.recall_spine: 急性身份与 Source 分类 → 临床双出口 → 外周/骨髓/Auer/化学/NAP → 流式 + 遗传 → 危急出口 + Current Source 分型治疗 → CR/MRD/toxicity → 最终病例算法

c-h09-lg01.label: 急性身份与 Source 分类：先懂“早期分化停滞”，再看 FAB 名字
c-h09-lg01.goal: connect proliferative advantage + differentiation block to acute-vs-chronic identity, then use ALL/AML FAB tables only as Source-specific morphology language.
c-h09-lg01.closure: from a blast-heavy case, explain why it is biologically acute, identify the likely lineage/maturation question, and state which FAB precision needs the original table rather than rote recitation.
c-h09-lg01.continuity_rationale: disease identity gives classification its meaning; H9-SB01–03 and H9-SC01 remain live.

c-h09-lg02.label: 临床双出口：正常造血被压 + 肿瘤细胞外侵
c-h09-lg02.goal: derive anemia/infection/bleeding from marrow failure and distinguish sternum, liver/spleen, green tumor, gingiva/skin, node/mediastinum and CNS/testis infiltration clues.
c-h09-lg02.closure: given a symptom/organ pattern, identify whether it is marrow-output failure, direct infiltration or a sanctuary-site issue and avoid confusing gingival bleeding with gingival infiltration or node disease with lymphoma alone.
c-h09-lg02.continuity_rationale: these five KPs share the “where did the clone cause the phenotype?” question.

c-h09-lg03.label: 外周 → 骨髓 → Auer / 化学 + NAP：先把急性和系别方向立住
c-h09-lg03.goal: use CBC/smear as a clue, marrow as acute-threshold evidence, Auer/cytochemistry as lineage direction and NAP only as an auxiliary discriminator against CML/leukemoid patterns.
c-h09-lg03.closure: explain what each evidence layer adds, why Auer-negative does not equal ALL and why NAP cannot diagnose leukemia independently of marrow/clone evidence.
c-h09-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP19 belongs here semantically even though it appears later in stable KP order; all five KPs are first-line diagnostic discrimination tools.

c-h09-lg04.label: 流式 + 遗传：从“哪一系”推进到“哪一亚型 / 预后”，APL在这里闭合身份
c-h09-lg04.goal: distinguish B/T/NK/AML immunophenotype combinations, then use characteristic cytogenetics/fusions for subtype/prognosis and integrate APL as M3 + Auer/MPO + characteristic flow + t(15;17)/PML-RARA + DIC risk.
c-h09-lg04.closure: from flow and cytogenetic data, state which result identifies lineage, which refines subtype/prognosis and why one CD or one chromosome never substitutes for the whole evidence stack.
c-h09-lg04.continuity_rationale: APL is the best test of whether morphology, flow and genetics have truly been integrated rather than memorized separately.

c-h09-lg05.label: 危急出口 + Current Source 分型治疗
c-h09-lg05.goal: recognize tumor-lysis/high-urate renal injury, leukostasis and APL differentiation/DIC danger, then branch to APL / non-M3 AML / ALL Source treatment and G-CSF boundary.
c-h09-lg05.closure: in a new acute-leukemia case, identify what can harm the patient now, run prevention/support in parallel, and choose the Source-supported subtype treatment without delaying danger control or importing modern external regimens.
c-h09-lg05.continuity_rationale: these KPs form the “after subtype evidence, what must happen now?” decision layer.

c-h09-lg06.label: 治疗结果不是治愈：CR → MRD → toxicity
c-h09-lg06.goal: distinguish complete remission from residual disease and keep drug-organ toxicity as treatment evidence rather than main disease ontology.
c-h09-lg06.closure: given improved counts/clinical state, state what is still required for CR, why MRD can remain after CR, and when a new organ finding should trigger a treatment-toxicity check.
c-h09-lg06.continuity_rationale: response, residual disease and toxicity are the post-treatment observation layer.

c-h09-lg07.label: 最终急性白血病病例算法
c-h09-lg07.goal: execute marrow-failure/infiltration → acute threshold → lineage/subtype → genetics → urgent exits → treatment → CR/MRD in order.
c-h09-lg07.closure: solve a fresh acute-leukemia vignette while refusing to jump from WBC, Auer, one CD or one fusion directly to the whole diagnosis/treatment plan.

hematology-h10.title: 慢性髓系白血病（CML）
hematology-h10.first_pass_focus: 以BCR-ABL克隆和成熟粒细胞谱建立CML身份，再理解慢性→加速→急变。
hematology-h10.stop_line: 不重讲H9急性白血病；治疗/监测不外扩。
hematology-h10.recall_spine: 慢性期身份 → 加速/急变 → 治疗 → 急性 vs CML 比较 + 最终病例算法

c-h10-lg01.label: 慢性期身份：成熟粒细胞克隆 + BCR–ABL + 巨脾 / NAP
c-h10-lg01.goal: connect BCR–ABL-driven clonal expansion with retained maturation, the mature granulocyte spectrum, marrow hyperplasia/giant spleen, Ph evidence and low NAP vs leukemoid reaction.
c-h10-lg01.closure: from WBC differential/spleen/NAP/Ph evidence, explain why this is a clonal mature-spectrum disease rather than reactive neutrophilia or H9 acute leukemia.
c-h10-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP01–05 jointly define chronic-phase CML; none of the auxiliary clues should stand alone.

c-h10-lg02.label: 加速 → 急变：成熟秩序怎样逐步丢失
c-h10-lg02.goal: integrate blast/basophil/platelet/spleen/treatment-response/extra-cytogenetic signals into acceleration, then recognize acute transformation.
c-h10-lg02.closure: determine the phase from a multi-signal case and explain why progression is not “WBC got even higher”.
c-h10-lg02.continuity_rationale: KP06–07 are one disease-progression movie. H10-SB01 remains Source-bound.

c-h10-lg03.label: 治疗：靶点压制、根治与特殊人群
c-h10-lg03.goal: distinguish TKI targeting BCR–ABL, HSCT as Current Source curative interface and interferon for Source-specific special contexts.
c-h10-lg03.closure: from phase/context/eligibility, name the Source-supported treatment role and its target without importing resistance mutation/modern monitoring algorithms.
c-h10-lg03.continuity_rationale: treatment is a discrete decision after clone and phase are known.

c-h10-lg04.label: 急性 vs CML 比较 + 最终病例算法
c-h10-lg04.goal: compare maturation, blast, spleen, nodes, Ph and NAP, then execute mature spectrum → clone proof → stage → treatment.
c-h10-lg04.closure: solve a WBC-high case and identify the minimum evidence needed to distinguish acute leukemia, CML and leukemoid response before treatment routing.
c-h10-lg04.continuity_rationale: KP09 compresses the main false neighbor; KP10 turns it into an executable route.

hematology-h11.title: 淋巴瘤
hematology-h11.first_pass_focus: 从淋巴组织活检与结构入手，分HL/NHL与主要亚型，再用表型/遗传作确认而非替代。
hematology-h11.stop_line: 不补完整免疫学或现代淋巴瘤指南，活检结构仍是主体。
hematology-h11.recall_spine: 共同入口 → 成熟 B-NHL → 前体/Burkitt → T/NK-NHL → HL临床/治疗 → RS/NLPHL/CHL → CHL四型 → 染色体+免疫表型 → 最终算法

c-h11-lg01.label: 共同入口：活检定组织，B症状/分期定范围，HL/NHL先分大方向
c-h11-lg01.goal: start from progressive painless node/extranodal mass, preserve biopsy as diagnostic owner, separate marrow-infiltration anemia from immune hemolysis, apply B symptoms and I–IV stage, then compare HL vs NHL spread patterns.
c-h11-lg01.closure: from a node case, state what proves lymphoma, what only stages it, whether anemia reflects marrow vs hemolysis, and why marrow aspirate cannot replace tissue architecture.
c-h11-lg01.continuity_rationale: these KPs form the universal lymphoma entry before subtype memorization begins.

c-h11-lg02.label: 成熟 B-NHL：类型、行为与治疗角色必须绑在一起
c-h11-lg02.goal: place DLBCL, follicular and CLL/SLL on mature-B/indolent-to-aggressive axes, use CD20/CHOP-R and MALT interfaces by role, and understand transformation rather than memorize an unordered subtype list.
c-h11-lg02.closure: given architecture/marker/behavior clues, choose the mature-B subtype direction, classify its behavior and state the Current Source treatment role without using one marker as the diagnosis.
c-h11-lg02.continuity_rationale: treatment, subtype and biological speed are one mature-B decision space.

c-h11-lg03.label: 前体 / Burkitt：高度侵袭，但“长得快”不等于同一种病
c-h11-lg03.goal: distinguish precursor B/T lymphoblastic tumors from Burkitt using age/site, TdT/CD34, morphology/starry-sky, EBV, t(8;14)/MYC and blood-vs-tissue presentation.
c-h11-lg03.closure: separate T-lymphoblastic mediastinal disease, B-ALL-like presentation and Burkitt abdominal/jaw patterns and explicitly preserve the H9/H11 historical Burkitt naming boundary.
c-h11-lg03.continuity_rationale: these are the high-grade/precursor false neighbors that most easily collapse into a “young patient + fast tumor” list.

c-h11-lg04.label: T / NK-NHL：用部位、形态和表型定位，不强造统一假机制
c-h11-lg04.goal: map the Source-supported T/NK family and retain high-value identities: cutaneous T/Sézary, ALCL/CD30/t(2;5), NK/T/EBV/nasal-midline.
c-h11-lg04.closure: given skin/blood, youth/CD30 or nasal/EBV clues, identify the relevant T/NK direction and name which image/marker must confirm it.
c-h11-lg04.continuity_rationale: the Source itself contains heterogeneous T/NK entities; this LG explicitly avoids inventing a single fake mechanism to make the list tidy.

c-h11-lg05.label: HL 临床 / 治疗：范围决定局部 vs 系统治疗
c-h11-lg05.goal: connect HL clinical patterns and stage to Current Source ABVD/BV-AVD/radiotherapy roles.
c-h11-lg05.closure: from age/fever/pruritus/node pattern and stage, recognize HL direction and choose the Source-supported treatment *scope* rather than memorizing regimen letters independently.
c-h11-lg05.continuity_rationale: clinical presentation and stage-sensitive treatment are one HL decision problem.

c-h11-lg06.label: RS / NLPHL / CHL：先认肿瘤细胞与背景，再谈亚型
c-h11-lg06.goal: distinguish typical RS and variants, NLPHL popcorn/B-cell phenotype and CHL common RS+mixed-inflammatory background; keep the CHL incidence-source conflict explicit.
c-h11-lg06.closure: from a pathology/marker image, identify the tumor-cell identity and background, separate NLPHL from CHL, and state which incidence ordering depends on the question’s discipline.
c-h11-lg06.continuity_rationale: morphology and background are the prerequisite to the four CHL subtype patterns; H11-SC01/H11-SC02 remain live.

c-h11-lg07.label: CHL 四型：陷窝 / 混合 / 淋巴富 / 淋巴少
c-h11-lg07.goal: compare the four CHL subtypes by characteristic cell/background, demographic/site, EBV direction and Current Source prognosis.
c-h11-lg07.closure: from an image + demographic/background clue set, distinguish the four Source subtypes while preserving the two discipline-specific incidence rankings.
c-h11-lg07.continuity_rationale: these KPs are one direct four-way comparison and should remain together.

c-h11-lg08.label: 染色体 + 免疫表型：确认身份，不替代活检
c-h11-lg08.goal: use characteristic translocations and marker combinations to confirm B/T/NK/plasma/RS identities and separate near neighbors such as CLL/SLL vs mantle cell.
c-h11-lg08.closure: given a marker/translocation panel, identify what subtype it supports and explicitly state the tissue/morphology evidence it cannot replace.
c-h11-lg08.continuity_rationale: the two summary tables are a cross-branch evidence Safety Net, not a new taxonomy owner.

c-h11-lg09.label: 最终淋巴瘤病例算法
c-h11-lg09.goal: execute node/extranodal entry → biopsy → structure/cell source → marker/genetic confirmation → reverse-order stage → behavior/target → Current treatment.
c-h11-lg09.closure: solve a fresh lymphoma vignette without diagnosing from node size, one CD, one translocation or marrow involvement alone.
